For visitors

Book on Rapha's events site. Rapha club members get a free coffee before the ride and ride insurance. Choose the route that matches your pace.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 23–25 km/h: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Rapha Mallorca Social Ride group ride

Rapha Mallorca Social Ride is a road group ride in Palma, Spain. It rolls every Tuesday at 8:30 am local time from Rapha Mallorca clubhouse.

An intermediate-pace social ride from the Rapha clubhouse in Palma. There is a mid-ride stop at a supermarket to refill bottles.
